listings.contactOnly: Mobile dog and cat grooming serving Walnut Creek and nearby East Bay communities. Their grooming van comes to you by appointment. Prices are quoted directly; request a quote from their official page.
listings.siteNote: Formerly Aussie Pet Mobile. Mobile appointments serve Walnut Creek and nearby East Bay communities; the Pacheco address is an office.

panels.head: Dog and cat grooming
body: Dog grooming includes a bath and blowout, brushing, light detangling, ear and eye cleaning, nail clipping, and paw-pad and sanitary trims. Haircuts, deshedding and other add-ons are discussed during booking.
Cat grooming is available through the same mobile team. Confirm your pet’s needs and price directly.

panels.head: Office and service area
body: Office hours: Monday–Friday 9am–5pm; closed Saturday and Sunday. Appointment availability is arranged directly.
Their supplied profile lists an office at 111 Center Avenue, Suite C, Pacheco. Grooming appointments take place in the mobile van at the customer’s location, not as walk-in visits to that office.

sourceNotes.scope: All 56 new sends after Batch 110, through November 9 at 11:03:37.891111 Pacific.
sourceNotes.association: Monica’s Berkeley footage explicitly shows Penelope’s signage. All other reviews identify the business in the caption. Oke Poke is a chain owner film, without an invented filming branch.
sourceNotes.fourFilmLimit: Ace King is already full, so Chance plays on his creator page and Watch and links from the business. Penelope’s first four new reviews play inline; Rose plays on her creator page and Watch and links from Penelope’s. All old films remain.
sourceNotes.facts: Fowl hours conflict between homepage/profile and Square footer; no single hours field is asserted. Published menus include unavailable items and home-only specials with availability caveats. Almond’s current official 3311 address takes precedence over the supplied Instagram 3307 address, with both explicitly noted. Coffee and tea prices remain under their respective menus. Bark & Mane is a mobile service with Pacheco office, seated in the requested Walnut Creek service area, with no invented prices or walk-in address.
sourceNotes.actions: No call, message, booking, order or commitment. All QA playback muted. Protected affiliate work and unrelated BSTY Goods drafts untouched.
sourceNotes.lateMorning: Three more sources arrived during work. Tony’s Watch request is a creator review at full Bibim Grill, so it plays on his page and Watch. Amanda’s film names Meadowlark Dairy and shows its Railroad Avenue shop, matching Pleasanton. The chain’s own Chronic Tacos film is added alongside, preserving the original hosted hero. No filming branch is invented.
